title: Budget
description: The whole budget in one file: spending categories grouped for display, plus loans. A flat monthly plan, not envelope budgeting — no logged entries, no balances. Every category is just a name and an amount; a category with a date is a one-off cost counted only in that specific month instead of recurring. A category's overrides can replace its amount for specific months with a known real price (or 0, to skip that month entirely). A recurring category's amount_changes step its amount to a new figure at given months, so a rent that rises every January stays one category with one line per new price, instead of twelve overrides a year. Hand-edited and committed via git.

dividends.description: Profit distributed to the owner, dated. A dividend is not a budget category: it is not planned spending, it is the second way a one-person company hands its owner money, and it is taxed on both sides — company profit tax stays in the company's side of the ledger, dividend tax comes off what reaches the owner. Only the gross figure is stated here; both rates come from config.json's legislation for the month it lands in, so a distribution made under last year's rates stays reproducible when this year's move.

date.description: The month the distribution lands in; the day is informational, the same convention a one-off category's date follows. It is NOT shifted by the two-month funding rule — that rule is about when invoiced work becomes spendable, and a dividend is a payment made on a date.

amount.description: Euros, gross, before either tax. The company loses this plus its company profit tax; the owner's net income gains this less its dividend tax.

note.description: Free-text context for whoever edits this file — which year's profit it distributes, say. Rendered nowhere and used in no computation.

kind.description: company: business expenses, not personal spending — deducted from Company income before the employer-social/gross-salary/employee-social/income-tax cascade, since that money never becomes personal salary at all. Shown under Personal income, not Expenses. private: ordinary personal spending, deducted from Net income (after the cascade) for the Balance row, same as before. Every group must declare one explicitly.

id.description: Stable identifier that a transaction in data/actuals/ points at. Unique across the whole file, not just within a group (unlike name). Deliberately a UUID rather than a slug of the name: it must survive renaming the category or moving it to another group, and an id that looks derived from the name invites someone to 'correct' it on rename — which is exactly what would orphan every transaction ever matched to it. Assign with `pocket-cfo-ctl budget ids`, look one up with `pocket-cfo-ctl actuals categories`, and never reuse a retired id.

amount.description: Euros, decimals allowed (e.g. 427.42). Counted every month when the category is recurring, i.e. when date, from and until are all absent (unbounded in both directions), or when the month falls inside the from/until window. When date is set, this is a one-off cost counted only in that specific month. With amount_changes present, this is the amount in force before the first change, so an old file without any changes means exactly what it always meant.

minimal_amount.description: Optional reduced amount used instead of amount when minimal-budget mode is toggled on. The toggle is a global, server-side, in-memory flag (never persisted here) that applies to month view only, including a one-off dated category's due amount and its future "planned" preview.

date.description: Only for a one-off cost: the month it's due (day is informational, e.g. "2026-09-01"). Present -> amount is counted only in that YYYY-MM, shown as a grayed-out estimate before it's due and dropped after. Mutually exclusive with both from and until.

from.description: The inclusive first month of a recurring cost's window (day is informational, e.g. "2026-10-01"). Present -> amount is counted only in YYYY-MM months at or after this one, and never before. Absent with until present -> recurring from the start of time. Mutually exclusive with date.

until.description: The inclusive last month of a recurring cost's window (day is informational, e.g. "2026-08-01"). Present -> amount is counted only in YYYY-MM months up to and including this one, and never after — so a subscription that ended in August is "until": "2026-08-01" and drops starting September. Absent with from present -> recurring forever. Mutually exclusive with date.

overrides.description: Optional list of per-month overrides: for the listed month, use that override's amount verbatim instead of amount/minimal_amount — including 0, which zeroes the month out entirely (e.g. a recurring cost skipped that month, such as a trip not happening). Wins unconditionally over minimal-budget mode. No duplicate months per category.

amount_changes.description: Optional list of dated step-changes to this recurring category's amount: from each entry's month onward the category costs that entry's amount, until a later entry supersedes it — the newest entry with a from at or before the month is the one in force, exactly the way a dated period in config.json's legislation works. amount is what is charged before the first change. For an entry whose from month falls inside the category's own from/until window only: a change that could never take effect is dead configuration. Mutually exclusive with date — a one-off is a single price, full stop. An overrides entry still wins over everything for its own month.

note.description: Free-text context, shown next to the category name. Not used in any computation.

url.description: Optional link to a product/service page for this category (e.g. a specific PC build listing). When set, the note is shown as a link (opening in a new tab) with an external-link icon. Not used in any computation.

amount.description: Whole euros still owed, right now. Hand-updated directly after each payment (there's no separate principal/paid bookkeeping) — just lower this number.

note.description: Free-text context. Not used in any computation.

month.description: The month this override applies to (day is informational/ignored, e.g. "2026-09-01", same convention as date).

amount.description: Euros, decimals allowed. Replaces the category's amount/minimal_amount for this month verbatim — 0 means the category contributes nothing this month.

from.description: The month this amount takes effect, inclusive (day is informational, e.g. "2027-01-01", same convention as date, from and until). In force until a later amount_changes entry supersedes it.

amount.description: Euros, decimals allowed. The category's recurring amount from this month on, replacing amount (and the superseded change's amount) for every month until a later entry.

minimal_amount.description: Optional reduced amount minimal-budget mode uses for the months this entry is in force, instead of the category's top-level minimal_amount. Absent -> minimal mode falls back to this entry's own amount, the same rule the top-level pair already follows.
